whyItMatters: $(el).html(payload) writes unescaped markup in javascript, so untrusted input reaching it becomes cross-site scripting.
actions: Escape the value with text() binding or a sanitizer or bind it as text content.
If raw markup is required, sanitize it against an allowlist of tags and attributes.
Re-run the scan and confirm no $(el).html(payload) call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no $(el).html(payload) reachable from untrusted input, and markup probes render inert.
